params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$dir=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'actions-runner-heaven'
$runCmd=Join-Path $dir 'run.cmd'
if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runCmd)){ throw ('Runner entrypoint missing: ' + $runCmd) }
$cmdExe=Join-Path ([Environment]::SystemDirectory) 'cmd.exe'
if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cmdExe)){ throw ('cmd.exe missing: ' + $cmdExe) }
$startup=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup')
if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($startup)){ throw 'Startup folder unavailable' }
$launcher=Join-Path $startup 'HeavenGitHubActionsRunner.cmd'
$nl=[Environment]::NewLine
$launcherText='@echo off'+$nl+'cd /d "'+$dir+'"'+$nl+'start "" /min "'+$cmdExe+'" /d /c ""'+$runCmd+'""'+$nl
Set-Content -LiteralPath $launcher -Value $launcherText -Encoding Ascii
$existing=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'Runner.Listener.exe' -and $_.ExecutablePath -like ($dir + '*') })
if($existing.Count -eq 0){ $arg='/d /c ""'+$runCmd+'""'; Start-Process -FilePath $cmdExe -ArgumentList $arg -WorkingDirectory $dir -WindowStyle Hidden | Out-Null; Start-Sleep -Seconds 6 }
$listeners=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'Runner.Listener.exe' -and $_.ExecutablePath -like ($dir + '*') } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine)
[pscustomobject]@{runner_dir=$dir;startup_launcher=$launcher;listener_count=$listeners.Count;listeners=$listeners} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress
